description: 阅读 Aurefold 第一部：The Bell of Silence 的开篇——一部关于十大家族的史诗奇幻的序章与第一章。免费在线阅读。
blocks: The record on the table was from House Whitehart. It was forty-three pages long, copied in a hand so even that the letters looked less written than agreed upon. Every page had been witnessed. Every witness had been witnessed. The cord had three seals in white wax and one in black, and the black one was Crown-watch's, put there when the packet arrived so that everyone would know no one had opened it before the people who were now opening it.
桌上的记录来自 House Whitehart。它长达四十三页，抄写的笔迹极为工整，那些字母看上去与其说是写下的，不如说是约定好的。每一页都经过见证。每一个见证人也都被见证过。系绳上有三枚白蜡封印和一枚黑蜡封印，那枚黑色的是 Crown-watch 的，在这份卷宗送达时盖上，好让所有人知道：在此刻打开它的人之前，无人曾开启过它。

The first wick had drowned. He pinched it out, drew it up with the point of his char knife, and cut it shorter than he meant to. His hand gave one small tremor against the copper hood. He noticed it before anyone else could and steadied the lamp with his other hand. The second flame burned blue at the root and smoked whenever the valley wind found the arch. Soot gathered beneath the little copper hood.
第一根灯芯被油淹灭了。他把它捏熄，用剔炭刀的刀尖挑起，剪得比原本想的还要短。他的手抵着铜罩微微一颤。他抢在旁人之前察觉，用另一只手稳住了灯。第二簇火苗根部烧成蓝色，每当谷风寻到那拱门便冒起烟来。煤灰在那小小的铜罩下积聚。

He had introduced himself as Perrin, of Blackcrest, and had then spent most of the afternoon behaving as though introductions were something other people required. He wore a traveling coat indoors and had found out the copying clerk's name before Wren had. The clerk had brought him tea without being asked and had brought Wren none, which she did not hold against either of them and noticed about both.
他自我介绍说是 Blackcrest 的 Perrin，随后整个下午的大半时间都表现得仿佛自我介绍是别人才需要的东西。他在室内穿着一件旅行外套，还在 Wren 之前就打听出了抄写员的名字。抄写员没等吩咐就给他端来了茶，却没给 Wren 端，这一点她并不怪罪他们中的任何一个，却把两人都记在了心里。

She had entered while he was trimming the wick and taken the chair furthest inside, where the back wall met the long row of griffes. The dead faced the valley. Alaine faced the room. She sat with both hands resting on the head of her walking stick and her shoulders clear of the stone, though Tomas knew the cold would reach them before the hour was done.
她是在他修剪灯芯时进来的，坐了最里面那把椅子，那里后墙与长长一排 griffes 相接。逝者面朝山谷。Alaine 面朝屋子。她坐着，双手搁在拐杖的顶端，肩膀离开石壁，尽管 Tomas 知道，不到一个钟头，寒意就会侵到她的肩上。

The arch admitted a rush of colder air and the smell of goat hair. Sela came in with a coil of narrow cloth over one shoulder and something pale caught in her braid. Straw, Tomas thought. No—burdock. A dark crescent had dried beneath one thumbnail, blood or hoof dirt or both. She had left her work knife by the door; its sheath hung empty at her belt.
拱门放进一股更冷的空气和一股山羊毛的气味。Sela 走进来，一肩搭着一卷窄布，发辫里缠着什么苍白的东西。稻草，Tomas 想。不——是牛蒡。一枚黑色的月牙在她一片拇指甲下干涸，是血，是蹄泥，或两者都是。她把干活的刀留在了门边；刀鞘空空地挂在腰带上。

Across from her, Aldous aligned the packet's lower edge with the edge of the table. He had done this each time she moved it. He had not complained. She had not apologized. Their acquaintance had lasted three hours and had achieved a stable form.
她对面的 Aldous 把卷宗的下缘对齐了桌沿。每当她挪动它，他就这样做一次。他没有抱怨。她也没有道歉。他们相识已有三个钟头，并已达成一种稳定的形态。

The room was very quiet. Crown-watch was built to keep paper dry and voices from traveling. The walls were lined with felt behind the boards; Wren had checked when she came in, because rooms explain institutions more honestly than mottos do.
屋里十分安静。Crown-watch 的建造是为了让纸张保持干燥，让声音无从传开。墙板背后衬着毡子；Wren 进来时查看过，因为屋子比格言更诚实地解释着一个机构。

"The packet contains every judgment Whitehart chose to enter for the period requested. Names where names are permitted. Dates where dates survive. The name of the tester. The conclusion. Corrections witnessed and sealed."
“这份卷宗包含了 Whitehart 在所请求的时段内选择录入的每一项判决。凡允许留名之处便有名字。凡日期得以留存之处便有日期。测试者的姓名。结论。经见证并封缄的更正。”

He put the lamp back where it had been. Alaine had not ordered him. That was not how her authority worked. She named the thing she believed should happen and left other people to discover that they had already obeyed.
他把灯放回原处。Alaine 并没有命令他。她的权威不是那样运作的。她只说出她认为应当发生的事，任由旁人自己发现——他们早已服从了。

Not good evening. Not Mother. She looked first at Tomas, then at the smoking lamp, then back through the arch toward the yard.
不是晚上好。不是嬷嬷。她先看 Tomas，再看那冒烟的灯，然后穿过拱门回望院子。
Crown-watch had a room for disputed records and a smaller room for the people who disputed them. Wren had been in the smaller room since noon.
Crown-watch 有一间存放争议记录的屋子，还有一间更小的、留给争论这些记录的人的屋子。Wren 从正午起就待在那间更小的屋子里。
Tomas wiped his thumb on the rag at his belt. It left a dark mark beside three older ones. He had meant to begin with clean hands.
Tomas 把拇指在腰带上的破布上擦了擦。它在三道更旧的痕迹旁留下一道黑印。他本想干干净净地开始。

Wren had always thought this was the sort of reassurance that creates a new question without answering the old one.
Wren 一向认为，这正是那种制造出新疑问、却不解答旧疑问的宽慰。
"If you burn the only observation from which a judgment was made, the distinction becomes devotional."
“如果你烧掉了据以作出判决的唯一那份观察记录，那区别便成了一种信仰。”
Wren of Blackthorn reads a sealed record; Aldous of Blackcrest and a herald named Perrin watch.
Blackthorn 的 Wren 正在读一份封缄的记录；Blackcrest 的 Aldous 和一位名叫 Perrin 的传令官在一旁看着。
Alaine looked at the black crescent forming under the hood. "The lamp has given her reason."
Alaine 望着铜罩下渐渐成形的黑色月牙。“这盏灯已经给了她理由。”
Or skip the noise — I'll write to you myself when there's more to read.
或者跳过喧嚣——有更多可读的时候，我会亲自写信给你。
No supporting matter survives outside the entered judgment.
除已录入的判决之外，没有任何佐证留存。

Brother Tomas prepares the listening room. Mother Alaine watches.
Tomas 修士正在准备聆听室。Alaine 嬷嬷在一旁看着。
"I would rather know what she does before she has reason."
“我更想知道，她在还没有理由之前会做什么。”
She turned the last page back and read the final sentence again.
她把最后一页翻回去，又读了一遍那结尾的句子。
By the time Sela arrived, Tomas had failed the lamp twice.
等 Sela 到时，Tomas 已经在那盏灯上失手两次了。
Wren put one finger on the final sentence. "In theirs."
Wren 把一根手指按在那结尾的句子上。“他们那种意义上的。”

"Those are often the same thing here."
“在这里，两者往往是一回事。”

“烟会熏到她的眼睛。”他说。
"That sounded ominous," Perrin said.
“那听起来不祥。”Perrin 说。
"The notes of the trials."
“审验的记录。”
The flame leaned harder.
火苗歪斜得更厉害了。
"Leave it," Mother Alaine said.
“别动它。”Alaine 嬷嬷说。
She stopped just inside.
她在门内不远处停下。
